entities.name: Plácido Galindo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Plácido Reynaldo Galindo Pando was a Peruvian football midfielder who played for Peru in the 1930 FIFA World Cup, where he also became the first ever player sent off in a World Cup match. He also was a player, manager and president of Universitario de Deportes.
